# Respawn of items & enemies / loot lists / burned books / book

![Respawn of items & enemies / loot lists / burned books / book](/uploads/7_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**TL;DR:** In the house in **Summersville** directly behind the town sign you will find more than 255 items, most of which are **burnt books**.

To better understand how enemy and item spawns and respawns work in Fallout 76, there are a few things you should know. Enemies normally respawn after 10 minutes, items are stored in a 255 item list and only spawn if they are not on this list. The list remains permanent, no matter how long you are out of the game. Even if you only come back into the game after 4 years, the list is the same.

### Why is this important?

As soon as you are specifically looking for items in Appalachia and want to farm them, it is important to understand when and how these items spawn. Once you have picked up an item, it will no longer spawn for you on the next server because it is in your loot list. If you know that you can control this logic, you will be much more successful and find what you are looking for.

Here is a more detailed explanation of how this works 

(inspired by this YouTube video):

## Item respawn

- 
Loose **items** are handled slightly differently:
 - 
Each server has a **list of items** that have been looted. This list is very long and respawning takes many hours on this server.
 - 
Each player or character also has a list of items that they have looted. This **list contains 255 items**. As you loot items, this list will be filled. If you pick up more, the items picked up first will be deleted from the list and essentially fall to the back. The 255 most recently looted items are always in this list. Loose objects count as 1 list entry, containers (regardless of how many are in them) also only count as 1 entry in the list.
 - 
Items cannot respawn on the same server for many hours as described for the enemies above. (When you change servers, however, you do.)
 - 
Every area on the map is initially empty until a player enters the area. **The items only spawn when a player enters the area. Depending on the list of the 255 most recently picked up items and also with a 10 minute cooldown, like for the enemies.**
 Some items have fixed spawns (e.g. Burnt Books, Golf Balls, Newspapers, etc.) and others are rarer and spawn randomly (e.g. Chems, Bobbleheads, Magazines, Bottle Cap Supplies)
 - 
These spawns depend on the list of the player entering the area. 
 If you e.g. If you have completely looted an area and would like to loot a specific item again, it must have already "fallen down" in your 255 item list and you must have entered a**new server**.**These items will then spawn again.**
 - 
Even if 255 sounds like a lot, in practice this list is not very long. e.g. the golf club alone has more than 255 items if you record everything.
 - 
 - 
**Plants** also count into this 255 list. However, the respawns are not as predictable as those of normal items. In some cases, the plants do not spawn for you on new servers or you sometimes cannot pick them.
- 

## Enemy respawn

- 
**Enemies** respawn in most cases after **10 minutes**
 - 
This applies to the **Riss locations** without any further conditions. You can simply check back there after 10 minutes and find new opponents.
